purpose: Shared data contract. Every arm sees byte-identical inputs, blocks, splits, folds, and simulated traits; arms differ ONLY in the representation. Otherwise the compression comparison is not attributable.

shared_snp_set.coordinate_rule: exact CHROM:POS:REF:ALT; duplicate-position groups removed; 22<->chr22 alias only
shared_snp_set.must_not: adjust MAF or truncate to a power of two or the SNPBag 81920

block_version.definition: LD blocks over the frozen chr22 panel; identical boundaries and version id across all arms
block_version.records_per_block: m_b recorded per block; needed for total-budget accounting D_total = sum_b min(k, m_b)
block_version.binding: block version id and hash fixed at run-authorization time

split.cv: outer 5-fold nested CV drawn once and shared byte-identically across all arms and all budgets
split.preprocessing_stats: p, mean, sd (for both raw-centering and MAF-standardization) computed on the outer-training fold ONLY
split.hgdp: forbidden for this experiment; decision holdout untouched

trait_panel.kind: simulated quantitative only (no real phenotypes exist for this panel; binary dropped from round 1)
trait_panel.shared: identical simulated trait matrices across all arms per regime and seed; arms never differ in labels or folds
trait_panel.genetic_value_g: stored per trait; it is the primary decision target via R2_genetic

binding_status.note: hashes intentionally unbound in this design-only package; binding them is a pre-run gate

real_data_extension.requires: a new prospective data contract for an external panel with real phenotypes; not authorized by this package
